displayIdentity.body: Self-examination precedes Paul’s use of authority. Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified. For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
displayIdentity.title: Self-examination precedes Paul’s use of authority
